newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL palm oil ends down after an erratic day.
newsitem.headline: KL palm oil ends down after an erratic day.

text.p: PALM OIL FUTURES PALM OIL PHYSICAL

PALM OIL FUTURES - Prices ended lower on selling by a few major players in February futures and the easier sentiment was spilled over other futures months. SGS and caleb Brett's November export data did prompt some support in late morning. Trading was cautious as some contracts fell below 1,200 level.
PALM OIL PHYSICAL -Selling interest was seen among nearby CPOs and selected products.
Cargo surveyor Caleb Brett put November bulk palm oil exports at 673,905 tonnes against 729,626 for October. SGS (M) Sdn said exports for 700,566 tonnes against 736,374 in October.
"There was selling by a few major players particularly in active February futures contract. The easier sentiment was then spilled over to other futures contracts," a trader said.
February futures fell to a low of 1,196 ringgit low before closing at 1,198 ringgit ($474.08) a tonne, down nine ringgit from Friday.
The market is expected to consolidate at around current levels or ease slightly unless some major news appear.
"People are cautious and always waiting for fresh leads before making up new positions," antoher dealer said.
Volume on the futures market was 1,800 lots against 1,633 lots on Friday.
The physical sector saw business among nearby CPOs. Dec (south) crude palm oil was offered at 1,210 ringgit after trading at 1,210 and 1,215. Bids for Dec (south) was 1,205.
Dec RBD palm olein saw offers at $555, Jan at $552.50 and Feb/March at $550. Dec was traded at $557.50 and $555.
Dec RBD palm stearin was offered at $372.50, Jan at $380 and Feb at $385. Dec was dealt at $372.
Dec/Jan palm fatty acid distillate saw sellers at $305.
